Pochettino suggests Chelsea title should be stripped and given to Tottenham

Former Chelsea manager Mauricio Pochettino has stated that the 2017 Premier League title should be stripped from Chelsea and awarded to Tottenham Hotspur. Pochettino's comments were made in relation to alleged transfer breaches by Chelsea. The Premier League has reportedly responded to these calls. Pochettino also made comments about a potential return to Tottenham Hotspur, suggesting he would have managed the club even in the Championship.
